craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Reductio: all-knowing-every-soul; see-where close points onward. Rejected: (a) blunting reductio → killed: explosion is the proof. Read aloud: UN-felt BY-spir-IT … SEE-where-THAT must-GO.

lines: Unfelt by spirit, whose is will — and felt, then known by whom?
By all — then every soul is all-knowing: see where that must go.

reads_against.argmap: Perceived — by whom? → Generic will forces omniscience on each — reductio.
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
